formula.unit: fraction of reference HP per turn
formula.meaning: 我方每回合打掉Boss血量比例减去敌方每回合打掉我方血量比例。
formula.scope: SILENT V5; boss-based candidate assessment; not a universal all-character gameplay rule

definitions.boss_reference: Freeze encounter identity, ascension, relevant target HP pools/phases, source/model/knowledge and entry conditions before candidate comparison; only existing learner-validated encounter definitions. Do not use generic hallway or minion-damage totals as boss-target output.
definitions.my_dpr: Effective damage to the modeled victory-relevant boss target(s), averaged over a declared whole-fight sample window including setup and terminal turns; never only the active combo window or overkill inflation.
definitions.enemy_dpr: Actual incoming HP damage after modeled mitigation from the entire boss encounter over the SAME sample window; not displayed enemy intent, gross pre-block attacks, or the existing capped hpLoss field without accounting validation.
definitions.boss_hp: Known reference entry HP pool for the target encounter; immutable within each scenario, not shrinking every turn to boost score. Multiple entities/phases/healing require explicit supported scope; missing support stays unknown.
definitions.my_hp: Legally available HP at that candidate scenario entry. Rest/heal/HP-cost changes may alter it only through the existing legal action projection. Do not substitute future borrowed healing or repeatedly changing in-fight HP.
definitions.health_resources: Enemy HP damage, self-cost, effective healing, potions and revival consumption need separate trace accounting. The requested scalar does not by itself fully value healing/self-cost or time order; retain existing survival/resource outcomes and test these cases rather than inventing a hidden weight.
definitions.zero_and_unknown: Nonpositive reference HP, zero/incomplete turn window, unsupported target identity or missing damage attribution returns unknown/invalid, never infinity or zero-filled safety.

math_boundary: With positive HP and constant damage rates, S>0 is equivalent to the continuous-time kill-clock ordering. Real turn order and burst/setup/healing require full trajectories.
S is a ranking proxy, not win probability; larger mean S across stochastic candidates does not prove higher actual win rate.
A score computed after a realized complete outcome is retrospective; it cannot be described as a historical prediction or used as its own independent correctness label.
acceptance: Reuse original frozen candidates/current-model/scenario IDs and samples when trace fields support S; do not alter in-progress immutable inputs or rerun completed Jev calls.

Compute S per matched sample then summarize mean/distribution and paired deltaS, sample identity, won/died/censored/missing denominators; do not substitute a ratio of unrelated aggregate means or mix windows.

Compare raw DPR ranking, existing selector and boss-relative S ranking against independently checked real trajectories and separately declared counterfactual model evidence. Include slower high-defense, fast fragile, delayed core, healing/revive and multi-boss scenarios when existing evidence supports them.

Reward/skip/buy/remove/upgrade compare deltaS against the same baseline boss scenario. Component signature probability and alive-through-core-start remain separate; do not multiply unvalidated marginal probabilities.

Known next-boss and final/continuous-boss assessment are labeled separately; resources carry across successive fights. Unknown future boss identity/entry HP is scenario uncertainty, not hidden privileged information.

Expose exact compact values and uncertainty to the brain/Jev only after original calibration/admission gates; code calculates the formula, models explain candidate trade-offs. No new independent brain call required.
Follow original tests/main-live/version/consumer/natural-acceptance/cleanup standards for an actual behavior release; this record is not a source release or successful calibration.
coordination: Append to same pending R3/quantitative continuation at safe completion boundary; no new learning parent or duplicate research, no hot input or game restart. Existing P1/P2 and current R2 completion remain open.
